title: Introduction to Technical Drawing and Computer Aided Design
description: Practices, rules and standards in computer-aided drawing and design; descriptive geometry including orthographic and isometric projections; generating and interpreting technical drawings: sectional views, dimensioning & tolerancing and assembly drawings; hands-on experience with essential software based tools for design, mechanical modeling, technical drawing and manufacture.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of MECH 200A, MECH 200.
